Blog Publisher Toolkit Collections

What this collection helps with

Blog posts and article pages carry a small set of repeating metadata needs: social preview tags, canonical URLs, link relationships, image markup, and structured data. These details are easy to miss when publishing on a schedule. This collection helps keep them consistent across every post.

Best for

  • Preparing social share previews for blog posts.
  • Keeping canonical URLs and link tags consistent across article templates.
  • Adding structured data and image markup to content-heavy pages.

FAQ

Questions about blog publisher toolkit

Should every blog post have Open Graph tags?

Yes. Each post should carry its own og:title, og:description, og:url, and og:image tags so that sharing the post on social platforms produces a useful preview. The og-twitter-card-builder handles both Open Graph and Twitter Card markup in one step.

Do I need structured data on every article?

Article structured data helps search engines understand the content type, headline, author, and publication date. It is useful for blogs and news sites but optional for simple personal pages.
